node.title: Measured 2026-08-30: the engine refuses to SET a primary key, so PK namespacing migrates by reading the source and writing a new store, and rollback is keeping the original

props.note: Setting a PK raises: 'Cannot set property concept_id in table Concept because it is used as primary key. Try delete and then insert.' Since a rewrite is unavoidable, doing it inside one store leaves a half-migrated store at every failure point, so the script never mutates the source and the destination is deleted when verification fails. Second constraint: the logical export on main drops every meta table, because node_table_specs excludes underscore-prefixed tables and meta_table_specs is PR 115's unmerged contribution, so the migration reads them itself. The rewrite map is the substance: node PKs only where an owner_id column exists (Domain and SkillExecution have none and the runtime also uses logical ids there), edge endpoints composed with that endpoint's owner, _Tombstone.node_id composed (without it two accounts deleting the same slug share one tombstone row and the loser's deletion stops propagating, audit M3), and _EdgeTombstone.ekey only because src and dst go out on the sync wire and the wire must not carry U+001F, pinned by a contract test. _SyncBase has no owner column so rows there stop the migration rather than being guessed at. Proven by attaching the migrated store with the flag on: user-facing ids come back as logical slugs, and bob inserting a slug alice already owns gives created:1 with no id_conflicts, which is the #121 symptom gone.
